assumptions.path: proximity (if stop and target print on the same 1m bar, the level closer to that bar's open is filled; a tie goes to the stop)
assumptions.window: entries 08:30-12:00 CT inclusive, one position, 1-bar cooldown, max 12 buys/day
assumptions.baseline: CHOP = VWAP fade, bar stop clamped $0.15-$1.00, +25% option, 10 min. TREND = EMA20 retest (near-only + slope gate), $0.30 stop, +12% option, 5 min. MIXED and WARMUP flat.
assumptions.win: option net after $1.30 fees > 0. A day clears 70% only when it has trades and the win rate is strictly above 70%.
